1291-herodias.title: Herodias
1291-herodias.creator: Gustave Flaubert
1291-herodias.description: A book by Gustave Flaubert. nd the tower of Antonia, with its enormous cube, dominated Jerusalem. The tetrarch turned his gaze from it to contemplate the palms of Jericho on his right; and his thoughts dwelt upon other cities of his beloved Galilee,--Capernaum, Endor, Nazareth, Tiberias--whither it might be he would never return.

arxiv-1805-05774.title: Life as the Explanation of the Measurement Problem
arxiv-1805-05774.creator: Szymon Łukaszyk
arxiv-1805-05774.description: Abstract This study argues that a biological cell, a dissipative structure, is the smallest agent capable of processing quantum information through its triangulated, holographic sphere of perception , where this mechanism has been extended by natural evolution to endo and exosemiosis in multicellular organisms and further to the language of Homo sapiens .

arxiv-2206-08470.title: Non-Perturbative Groundstate of High Temperature Yang-Mills Theory
arxiv-2206-08470.creator: d yamada
arxiv-2206-08470.description: Abstract The effective potential of Yang-Mills theory at high temperature derived by Gross, Pisarski, Yaffe and Weiss is critically reexamined and it is argued that the groundstate of the potential at ⟨ A 0 ⟩ = 0 \langle A_{0}\rangle=0 is invalid, due to the infrared divergence of the Matsubara zero mode.

arxiv-2303-13588.title: Efficient Symbolic Reasoning for Neural-Network Verification
arxiv-2303-13588.creator: Zi Wang Somesh Jha Krishnamurthy (Dj) Dvijotham
arxiv-2303-13588.description: Abstract The neural network has become an integral part of modern software systems. However, they still suffer from various problems, in particular, vulnerability to adversarial attacks. In this work, we present a novel program reasoning framework for neural-network verification, which we refer to as symbolic reasoning.

arxiv-2502-00921.title: Blink of an eye: a simple theory for feature localization in generative models
arxiv-2502-00921.creator: Marvin Li, Aayush Karan, Sitan Chen
arxiv-2502-00921.description: Abstract Large language models can exhibit unexpected behavior in the blink of an eye. In a recent computer use demo, a language model switched from coding to Googling pictures of Yellowstone, and these sudden shifts in behavior have also been observed in reasoning patterns and jailbreaks.

arxiv-2509-11216.title: Wrapped D4-branes from maximal 6D gauged supergravity
arxiv-2509-11216.description: Abstract We study a large class of domain wall solutions with M ​ k ​ w 3 × Σ 2 Mkw_{3}\times\Sigma^{2} and M ​ k ​ w 2 × Σ 3 Mkw_{2}\times\Sigma^{3} slices from maximal gauged supergravity in six dimensions.

britannica-1911-orkney-george-hamilton-e.title: Orkney, George Hamilton, Earl of (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-orkney-george-hamilton-e.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-orkney-george-hamilton-e.description: Article 'Orkney, George Hamilton, Earl of' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 20), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. British soldier, was the fifth son of William, duke of Hamilton, and was trained for the military career by his uncle, Lord Dumbarton, in the 1st Foot. In 1689 he became lieutenant-colonel and a few months later brevet colonel. He served at the battles of the Boyne and of Aughrim, and, at the head of the Royal Fusiliers, at Steinkirk.

pmc-10572744.title: Parents, Pain, and Over-the-Counter Medicine: Athletes’ Perceived Alternatives to Prescription Opioid Misuse
pmc-10572744.creator: Rikishi T Rey, Anne E Pezalla, Ines Aguinaga-Ontoso
pmc-10572744.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Youth athletes are often prescribed opioids after sustaining sport-related injuries, and because of their age, warrior-like culture in sport, and the desire to perform at the highest level, they are at risk for opioid misuse. Due to the nature of sport, youth athletes are at a greater risk to misuse opioids, and although it does not always predict misuse in adults, it is almost always a precursor among those addicted to opioids in adulthood.

pmc-10670563.title: Augmenting Functional and Sensorial Quality Attributes of Kefir through Fortification with Encapsulated Blackberry Juice
pmc-10670563.creator: Vanja Travičić, Olja Šovljanski, Ana Tomić, Milica Perović, Maja Milošević, Nenad Ćetković, Mirjana Antov, Paolo Lucci
pmc-10670563.description: Kefir is a fermented dairy product claimed to confer many health-promoting effects, but its acidic taste is not appealing to some consumers. Therefore, the aim of this study was to enhance the functional and sensorial quality attributes of kefir through fortification with encapsulated blackberry juice (EBJ).

pmc-11282189.title: Skyrmion-mediated nonvolatile ternary memory
pmc-11282189.creator: Md Mahadi Rajib, Namita Bindal, Ravish Kumar Raj, Brajesh Kumar Kaushik, Jayasimha Atulasimha
pmc-11282189.description: Multistate memory systems have the ability to store and process more data in the same physical space as binary memory systems, making them a potential alternative to existing binary memory systems. In the past, it has been demonstrated that voltage-controlled magnetic anisotropy (VCMA) based writing is highly energy-efficient compared to other writing methods used in non-volatile nano-magnetic binary memory systems.

pmc-11363882.title: Off-Label Use of Naltrexone in Pica and Other Compulsive Behaviors: A Report of Two Cases
pmc-11363882.creator: Samira Khan, Kunal Vij, Emili Lopez
pmc-11363882.description: Pica is known to the medical community as an eating disorder in which individuals may ingest non-food items due to a nutritional deficiency and cause unintentional physical harm to themselves. This article discusses the cases of children with pica in addition to other comorbidities such as trichotillomania, depression, autism, and anxiety.

pmc-11434173.title: Improvement of DC Performance and RF Characteristics in GaN-Based HEMTs Using SiNx Stress-Engineering Technique
pmc-11434173.creator: Chenkai Deng, Peiran Wang, Chuying Tang, Qiaoyu Hu, Fangzhou Du, Yang Jiang, Yi Zhang, Mujun Li, Zilong Xiong, Xiaohui Wang, Kangyao Wen, Wenmao Li, Nick Tao, Qing Wang, Hongyu Yu, Albert Chin
pmc-11434173.description: In this work, the DC performance and RF characteristics of GaN-based high-electron-mobility transistors (HEMTs) using the SiNx stress-engineered technique were systematically investigated. It was observed that a significant reduction in the peak electric field and an increase in the effective barrier thickness in the devices with compressive SiNx passivation contributed to the suppression of Fowler–Nordheim (FN) tunneling.

pmc-11731801.title: Promising candidate drug target genes for repurposing in cervical cancer: A bioinformatics-based approach
pmc-11731801.creator: Nurfi Pratiwi, Aida J Ulfah, Rachmadina Rachmadina, Lalu M Irham, Arief R Afief, Wirawan Adikusuma, Darmawi Darmawi, Rahmat A Kemal, Ina F Rangkuti, Maya Savira
pmc-11731801.description: Cervical cancer is the fourth most common cancer among women globally, and studies have shown that genetic variants play a significant role in its development. A variety of germline and somatic mutations are associated with cervical cancer. However, genomic data derived from these mutations have not been extensively utilized for the development of repurposed drugs for cervical cancer.

pmc-12694549.title: Low Skeletal Muscle Mass Identifies Very High Metabolic Risk in Slovak Children with Obesity: A Body Composition-Based Approach to Risk Stratification
pmc-12694549.creator: Alžbeta Bánovčinová, Ingrid Schusterová, Štefan Tóth, Tibor Porubän, Dominik Pella, Mariana Dvorožňáková, Pavol Fülöp, Ahmad Alkhatib
pmc-12694549.description: Background: Childhood obesity demonstrates substantial metabolic heterogeneity. We determined insulin resistance prevalence in Slovak children with obesity using multiple validated markers and identified high-risk phenotypes. Methods: Cross-sectional study of 54 obese children (BMI 29.5 ± 4.7 kg/m2) and 33 controls (BMI 20.6 ± 1.9 kg/m2).

pmc-13403115.title: Ex Vivo Assessment of Extracellular Acidification Rate in Murine Intestinal Tissue
pmc-13403115.creator: Alexander F Lesser, Mitchell L Drumm
pmc-13403115.description: Seahorse metabolic assays are now widely utilized across numerous fields for performing functional assessments of glycolysis and mitochondrial function in adherent or suspension cell culture samples. Seahorse assays measure extracellular acidification rate (ECAR) and oxygen consumption rate (OCR) as a means of assessing glycolysis and mitochondrial function, respectively.

pmc-13642532.title: Magnetically Decoupled Janus Bound States in the Continuum for Chirality–Topology Control
pmc-13642532.creator: Yadong Yue, Du Li, Kun Liang, Li Yu
pmc-13642532.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Bound states in the continuum (BICs) with infinite Q factors and topological polarization charges have emerged as a pivotal platform in quantum information. The Janus BICs carrying asymmetric topological charges exhibit great potential for nonreciprocal photonics devices. Here, the topological properties of the Janus BICs are preserved while decoupled chirality is induced, which enhances the system's advantages by providing an extra degree of freedom.
